description: System loads records, checks formats, validates constraints, flags errors, and reports results.
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Load Records] --> B[Check Formats]
    B --> C[Validate Constraints]
    C --> D{Valid?}
    D -->|Yes| E[Report Success]
    D -->|No| F[Flag Errors]

description: Creator submits content, manager reviews, and approves for publication.
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Submit Content] --> B[Manager Reviews]
    B --> C[Approve Publication]

description: Patient arrives, clerk registers information, nurse assesses vitals, doctor reviews case, and bed is assigned.
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Patient Arrives] --> B[Register Information]
    B --> C[Assess Vitals]
    C --> D[Doctor Reviews]
    D --> E[Assign Bed]

description: Rep receives lead, researches company, scores potential, verifies budget, confirms authority, assesses need, qualifies opportunity, and moves to pipeline.
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Receive Lead] --> B[Research Company]
    B --> C[Score Potential]
    C --> D[Verify Budget]
    D --> E{Qualified?}
    E -->|Yes| F[Confirm Authority]
    E -->|No| G[Disqualify Lead]
    F --> H[Move to Pipeline]

description: Team finalizes strategy, creates assets, schedules content, configures targeting, launches campaign, monitors metrics, optimizes performance, and reports results.

    A[Finalize Strategy] --> B[Create Assets]

    C --> D[Configure Targeting]
    D --> E[Launch Campaign]
    E --> F{Performing?}
    F -->|Yes| G[Report Results]

description: Pharmacist receives order, verifies prescription, checks interactions, prepares medication, labels package, double-checks dosage, and dispenses to patient.
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Receive Order] --> B[Verify Prescription]
    B --> C[Check Interactions]
    C --> D{Safe?}
    D -->|Yes| E[Prepare Medication]
    D -->|No| F[Alert Physician]
    E --> G[Label Package]
    G --> H[Dispense to Patient]

    A[Search Databases] --> B[Review Cases]
